takes.sourceDescription: walk, shake hands (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Approach and handshake, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts walking, pauses with a hand extended for a handshake, then turns and walks away.

takes.sourceDescription: walk, shake hands (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Approach and handshake, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A takes a few steps, extends a hand for a handshake, and settles standing.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B; B resists (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull a resisting partner, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A reaches forward with both hands, shifts into a wide stance and repeatedly leans back with one arm extended, then rises.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B; B resists (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull a resisting partner, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A reaches forward, steps wide and leans back with one arm extended, then crosses a step while continuing the pull.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B by the elbow; B resists (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull partner by elbow, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and reaches back, then leans forward and continues stepping while holding an arm behind.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B by the elbow; B resists (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull partner by elbow, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A reaches out, bends the knees and draws both hands across the body while stepping and turning.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate busy sidewalk; A leads the way, takes B by the arm (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Lead partner through a sidewalk, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with a hand extended, brings both hands together, then continues with one hand out while stepping.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - explain with hand gestures (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Explain with hand gestures, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A stands for several seconds, raises the hands in brief explanatory gestures, and returns to standing.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - explain with hand gestures, walk (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Gesture while stepping, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts with both hands raised, gestures while taking crossing steps, then brings the hands toward the chest.

takes.sourceDescription: quarrel - angry hand gestures (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Quarrel gestures, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts standing, repeatedly opens and raises the arms while stepping and turning, then finishes in a side-facing stance.

takes.sourceDescription: quarrel - angry hand gestures (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Quarrel and pointing gestures, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns, raises the hands and extends an arm toward the other participant, then lowers the arms to finish standing.

takes.sourceDescription: friends meet, hang out; A sits, B joins A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Seated meeting, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A begins seated, gestures briefly with the hands, then remains seated and leans forward toward the end.

takes.sourceDescription: run, scramble for last seat (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Scramble for a seat and rise, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A lowers into a deep seated or crouched position, then rises and steps away to stand.

takes.sourceDescription: run, scramble for last seat (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Scramble to a seat, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into a wide crouch and lowers into a seated posture, remaining seated through the end.

takes.title: Chicken dance, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A gestures with bent arms near the chest, alternates arm movements with repeated knee bends and crouches, and finishes upright with hands together.
